P-ENCLOSURE.evidence: The garden features a defined pool edge, structured planting beds, and a large overhanging building volume that creates a sense of enclosure and a defined outdoor room.

P-LAYERS.evidence: Large trees, dense shrubs, and flowering groundcover (bougainvillea) create distinct vertical layers, reading as lush and layered around the pool.

P-FOCAL.evidence: The cantilevered upper volume dominates the composition, with the pool, planting, and lower level arranged to frame and support it as the singular focal point.
